import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# Simulated feature data and labels
np.random.seed(42)
X = np.random.randn(100, 5)
y = np.random.randint(0, 2, 100)

# Implement mixup augmentation
alpha = 0.2
lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
index = np.random.permutation(len(X))

# Create mixed samples
X_mix = lam * X + (1 - lam) * X[index]

# Create mixed labels (soft labels)
y_mix = lam * y + (1 - lam) * y[index]

# Print original and mixed data shapes
print(f"Original X shape: {X.shape}, y shape: {y.shape}")
print(f"Mixed X shape: {X_mix.shape}, y_mix shape: {y_mix.shape}")
print(f"\nMixing coefficient (lambda): {lam:.4f}")
print(f"\nOriginal labels (first 10): {y[:10]}")
print(f"Mixed labels (first 10): {y_mix[:10].round(4)}")
print(f"\nMixed label range: [{y_mix.min():.4f}, {y_mix.max():.4f}]")
print(f"Mixed labels are soft (continuous): {not np.array_equal(y_mix, y_mix.astype(int))}")
